description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 Score (%) for two different tokenization approaches, one of which excludes material information, as indicated in the legend. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” spans a linear scale from approximately 0.5 to 1.5, with major tick marks at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48 to 58, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 2 (48, 50, 52, 54, 56, 58). Two lines are plotted: a pink line with circular markers and a solid line style, and a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style, labeled “w/o material information.” The pink line starts at approximately 55.1% at 0.6 tokens, dips slightly to 54.4% at 0.7, rises to a peak of 58.0% at 1.0 tokens, then declines to 51.0% at 1.5 tokens. The purple line begins at 52.4% at 0.6 tokens, rises to 54.1% at 0.7, then gradually decreases to 51.8% at 1.0, further declining to 51.7% at 1.2, 51.6% at 1.3, 53.4% at 1.4, and drops sharply to 47.6% at 1.5 tokens. Both lines are accompanied by shaded regions representing uncertainty or variance, with the pink shaded area being more pronounced around the peak at 1.0 tokens.
